scenario.title: The Forgotten Birthday Party Invitation
scenario.context: A bustling city library on a sunny Saturday afternoon
scenario.description: While sorting through a stack of returned children's books, librarian, Lila, discovers a misplaced birthday party invitation for a little girl named Rebecca. She realizes that the party is the very next day. She discusses the situation with her colleague, Sam.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Empathetic, considerate, solutions-focused, community-oriented
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Indifferent, dismissive, focused on personal tasks
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Anxious, overly focused on rules and procedures, resistant to going beyond the job description

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Hey Sam, look what I found tucked in one of the returned children's books - an invitation to Rebecca's birthday party.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Oh, that's odd. When is the party?

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: That's the problem - it's actually tomorrow.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Oh no, that's unfortunate. I think we need to make sure Rebecca gets her invitation as soon as possible.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I agree, but we don't even have her contact information.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Well, we could try reaching out to her classmates or their parents. Let's do our best to make this right.
